other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Rajasthan
Applicant must have at least 40% disability
Applicant must be a regular student in a government or recognized educational institution
Applicant must have passed the previous academic year
Applicant must not be a recipient of any other state government or NGO/trust-provided scholarship or allowance
benefits_summary: Provides scholarships and tuition fee reimbursement to disabled students from low‑income families.
